notes.title: Version 1.1 is Here — Steam Cloud, Battle Menu & a New You!
notes.notes:
Hello Portal Wanderers!

We’ve been listening, tinkering, and occasionally yelling at the Steam decks and cloud saving — and now we’re excited to announce that Version 1.1 of Portal Fantasy is officially live!

This update brings two of the most requested features, a full makeover for your player character  and a host of fixes, optimisations, and quality-of-life improvements.

Let's delve into more details


Steam Cloud Save Support
You asked, we answered — your progress can now be saved in the cloud. Pick up where you left off, wherever you’re playing. By default, your progress is saved locally on your machine, but you can manually save it to the cloud and restore it whenever you need to.


New Battle Status Menu
You want to see all your Porbles’ passives and active abilities during battle? Now you can! Just open the menu during combat and plan your next move with all the info at your fingertips. You can find what key to press to open it during battles, as it varies depending on the controller you are using.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/9d8042676f5e57b986889096afe84bd7363da53f.jpg"]


Player Character Glow-Up
We gave your character a full visual overhaul — sharper details, better animations, and even more charm.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/0918d80f4471a63f6797aad22b08b24da108b99b.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/fd163420861089f149fd22a2758d77eae76ec2f2.png"]

Even better: you can now change your look anytime at the Mirror in the Enchatara Shop. Feeling like a whole new you? Just say hi to the mirror and refresh your style whenever you’d like. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/748e2b833196e41a6a76d48ab91c767edb6290a4.jpg"]

And yes, you can now have more unique hair colours (yes, we did hear every time you requested them)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/866158d6a3412b96e0afc28b8635ec43bc28a933.jpg"]



And Much More…

We also squashed some pesky bugs, smoothed out rough edges, and added plenty of little quality-of-life improvements. 

One of them is something that occasionally has affected some of you. Floating platforms that decided to… float away into the void? They’ll now reset to their rightful place (just like moving boxes already do).

Here is the full list of changes:   

 Version 1.1.0   


MAJOR BUG FIXES
- Tinkerer class trait fixed

- Curse no longer bricks battles

- Dragon cave rentering working

- Aqua cove loatables all work now


BUG FIXES
- Moving platforms would stop when spotted by an NPC and reactivate when opening a menu

- Use of potions doesn't display wrong amounts

- Issue with Dustwirl map solved

- Valeria Prison guard, now spots you and sends you back to jail

- Fixed 2 items' descriptions in the Undercity merchant

- Fixed a lever message in Storm Keep so it doesn't repeat every time

- Fixed an exit cave in  Aqua Cove

- Fixed some names of corrupted porbles in Storm Keep

- Fixed Statue in Sunless River (Generic quest items)

- Fixed colliders in Undercity

- Ravenna now despawns on Storm Keep after the cutscene happens

- Improvement in Undercity prison colliders

- Fixed quest for the Statue in Far Isles

- Fixed collider in Far Isles

- Skeletons in the Solar Temple fixed

- Wrong asset in the mirror puzzle in the Solar temple fix

- Fix in Rescue Mission quest that could affect some players  


OPTMIZATION
- No longer able to dodge being spotted by opening a menu

- Bats can no longer touch pushables

- Improved the close button layering in some menus

- Lever moved in the 3rd dungeon to avoid a visual issue

- New Status icons in battles

- Improved colliders in Dustwhirl

- Improved colliders in Magic Mountain

- Improved colliders in Storm Keep

- Improved colliders in Sunless River

- Fixed category for majesty stones in recipe list

- 3rd dungeon rewards improved

- Improved end of Side Search so the game doesn't feel like the main quest is over

- Animikiig interaction now fixed if you have an Animikiig in your party

- Golden Gorge NPC line optimisation

- Improved the M1 stones locks after the porble is at M2


QOL
- New Battle Status menu

- Ability to change look by using the mirror in Enchantara

- Improved character look

- Improved rewards of the quest Scientific Approach, to match the predicted player level

- Different biomes in the quest log now have colours 

 
[hr][/hr]

Thank you, as always, for all your feedback and support — you continue to help make Portal Fantasy better with every step. Go forth, try out the new features, and don’t forget to say hello to person in the mirror.

See you in Pyli!

– The Portal Fantasy Team

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.12 & 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Between bank holidays, a couple of Spring colds in the team, this update took a bit longer. 

But it is a meaty one. In fact, so meaty that we ended up fusing 2 releases in one. 


Version 1.0.12 / 1.0.13


MAJOR BUG FIXES
- Fixed some situations where crafted shovels would not work as planned
- Issue fixed with the dragon cave where players could get stuck in a loop.
- Majesty 2 and Majesty 3 Steam achievements should trigger now if they didn't work for you in the past (if you start the game, they will appear)


BUG FIXES
- Fable chest can no longer give recipes for majesty stones, but will give majesty stones instead
- Fixed merchant in Under City, where, in some cases, purchases were not possible
- Fixed issue with recipe access in Springbloom
- Fixed a scenario where, after Silent Woods, Rudder conversation would not trigger the next quests immediately. 
- Fixed Animkiig NPC animation not playing
- Fixed the hermit quest gate not opening after the end of the quest at Clear Water Crater, unless the game was restarted for some players
- Added extra support for NPC appear effect, which should remove the possibility of NPCS not spawning when they should.
- Fix for Dread Form and Eldritch Nightmate battle icons
- Majesty stones made Tier 3 treasure drop rather than Tier 4


OPTMIZATION
- Improved some colliders in several maps to allow better passage and more fluid movement
- Improved Springbloom puzzle system since there was a chance players could lock themselves out after a specific set of actions.
- The End Game message has been rewritten to avoid confusion
- Updating default icon for gear effects
- Official controller input icons for Steam Deck
- Adding placeholders for status in-battle status effects + tooltips (working on the final ones as fast as possible, but wanted to give you guys something there already)
- Added some improvements that should support more controller models (do let us know in the Steam forums if this affects you still)


QOL
- The Portal maps now highlight when you unlock a new map inside a biome
- Redeem codes have been removed from the main menu, to avoid a situation where players would redeem the codes before starting a new game, and items would be lost (and caused some issues with players with keyboards? )

[spoiler]QG78VWCM[/spoiler]


There are some issues we are still investigating and solving as soon as possible

- In the Steam Deck, due to the increase of font in some areas the font overflows
- Reports of lag in some battles
- Player reports of battles freezing after a certain point (we are investigating what item , skill, porble is causing it)

If you have anything else we haven't spotted, please reach out to us in the Steam forum or just add Haron as friend (they live in Steam now) 
https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199527335829/

Thanks for the support, and we will carry on trying to make Portal Fantasy the best game we can make.

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
With this update, we had to make a hard decision. 
Our colouring system was causing some issues in some porbles and causing errors when players tried to evolve them.
We are working on fixing it, but it will take some days to have them all working as intended. So we opted for a bit more dramatic move. You should be able to evolve all porbles that can be evolved to Majesty 3 fine. But in the cases where the dyes would cause a problem, the dyes will be removed.
To make up for this, a COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS which will include enough dyes to set your porbles back to being the living canvas you always wanted.

We are also aware of some areas that are causing some issues with quest progress, and we are fixing them (many already are in test stage) and will be pushed as soon as possible, hopefully tomorrow 

Here is the full list of this update log

Version 1.0.6



MAJOR BUG FIXES
- Fixed an error when evolving to Majesty 3 with dyed porbles for some species that was causing errors and not allowing the evolutions. In those cases, the Porble will evolve but lose custom colours. (COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS)


BUG FIXES
- Prevention of the Fusion UI from allowing you to place 1st level majesty stones when doing more advanced majesty evolutions in some altars.
- Some baddie battles with broken Porbles (black boxes) were fixed
- Image fixes in some porbles



OPTMIZATION
- Moving platforms now pause when players open menus, avoiding void falls
- Cleaning of some dialogues (minor typos)

QOL
- Carry on work with the antivirus companies to fully whitelist all files in the game to prevent false risk warnings


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Demo update Version 0.003 - I do speak Português, I can speak Ingles
notes.notes:
You told us you didn’t like the font and we listened. Our new custom-made non-pixelated font is now available for your eyeball comfort.

For comparison, this is the old font:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/772e52af13068dfaef488eaee8bb14c4a91c5de3.jpg

And this is the new one:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/970b97bc77cd2a40754c303112fedd762f11fb4b.jpg

Much easier to read, don’t you think? What was that? English is not your language? Worry not, we've got you covered. We have 2 new fully supported fonts for

Portuguese (PT-BR)
Spanish (ES)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/42807402f6fc66578aedd8c9cd7519cef22ddaef.gif


The game also has the option for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean but those are still in the works and are not optimized, so you might find them hard to read or out of place (or even just not working) in some places.

Talking of optimizing, we carry on improving the game's performance. We have upgraded the game engine, so you will see that the game is much smoother when you move and does not stutter like it did in some of the busier map areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4ba584990bd07cbcdf927854961eb23824130221.gif

And since you can move so well, now you can hunt for more items all over the map. We have reduced the size of items that are in boxes, chests, bushes… well, basically everywhere. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/dac189c07baa1d66e99eb0b0505c08f0ebed4fb2.png

Thanks, Dylan for this great meme and you should check out his energetic playthrough of our demo. 

This adds a bit more realistic perspective as it made no sense for berries to be as big as you. Also, stop stealing all the berries. The berry farmer is after you.


Another thing you all asked for was to understand better what kind of damage was being done in the battles. And it makes sense if we are building a strategic battle system. So now the damage is colour-coded, and has a written label identifying what kind it is and its source. Prettier and efficient.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/7eb23225161ffd76fdcc8e07594c093f652f719f.png

Our desert now has 2 new types of traps

Sawblades 
 Quicksand (an area where you can’t jump)

Give them a try and let us know what you think

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/ba5bf484a332aedc19d84596bd869d136b8e65ea.png

That’s it for now. There were some bugs that you reported which also got fixed, but if you find any more please let us know in our community hub as we want to build this game with you.

We are continuously working on the game and hope to bring you full support for Chinese, Japanese and Korean very soon, as well as the so-desired PVP.

Keep an eye on our socials, as we will be giving some sneak peeks into the dungeons and evolution.



[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Demo update Version 0.002 - Auto login, new desert, and Groobeet breakdancing
notes.notes:
Oh man, so many new cool things. Ok, ok, let us focus here.

Auto login

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/73b3aae325c8e275c688326c6b3afb397f756112.png

First things first. Full Steam auto-login. No more messy inserting emails or logging in using your gamer fingers. Those will be reserved for your journey through the world of Portal Fantasy. 
If this is your first time in the demo, you will see a screen asking you to choose your game name (the name that the other players will see you as in the world).



Valeria

Thanks to all the feedback from you guys and the lovely content creators who have been streaming us, we have made several 'quality of life' improvements. Some examples are:

 Pointing out the healing fountain after the tutorial battle (we know many missed it)
 Jeejee now moves to point out which door you can go through to choose your first porble.
 Teakka quest has been expanded so it is clearer where you can find them.
 Now when you start typing to chat with the other players, a speech bubble appears above your head.


And the best improvement of all... Groobeet now breakdances. What do you mean you never saw a turtle-like creature breakdancing? Well go and check them out for yourself then.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/55ec5176ca0ce3e3e9e84c93979edba65a6f5404.gif

Desert

The whole map layout was improved. New look, new critters (you can find some scorpions and lizards moving around), and more spikes. Because everyone needs more spikes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/003386ba338bd603cb0b37b1f769793cae4c8874.gif

Even if you have played this map before, you will find it hard to recognise now. And on top of it all, a brand new quest. But be careful, for your choices will matter in this quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4be2c1b693f2418446daa26d26a38cd43d947dc0.jpg


Bugs

Lots of them were fixed, thanks to you guys reporting them. But many still need fixing. If you think you've found a bug, please report it to us via the Steam community hub or via our discord.
Also, those bushes that turn into oysters – that is not a bug...it's... errrr.... the heat? Magic? Yes, magical heat.
